attributes.action: Bank holiday for England V Mexico on the 13th July
attributes.additional_details:
Without a bank holiday teachers could suffer tired disruptive children, parents couldn’t risk fines for unauthorised absences.

And there will be a increased risk of drunk/ tired drivers in the country
attributes.background: We as a nation feel it would be beneficial for a bank holiday on Monday the 13th July to allow the adults and children to enjoy the game on Monday at 1am, as without this many children and adults will have to face the consequences of being tired/ hungover for work/ school Monday morning.

rejection.details: When our team got to your petition in the petitions queue, this match had already passed.
